geometry.source: exact GitHub Actions GeoJSON artifacts referenced by config/chosica_2015_outlet_freeze_registry_v0_1.json
geometry.hash_gate: exact downloaded GeoJSON SHA256 must equal geometry_freeze.geometry_geojson_sha256 for every target

spatial_aggregation.imerg_cell_definition: 0.1 degree cells centered on -179.95 + 0.1*i longitude and -89.95 + 0.1*j latitude
spatial_aggregation.intersection_weighting: area of frozen basin polygon intersection with each IMERG cell measured in EPSG:6933; normalize positive intersections to unit sum independently per basin
spatial_aggregation.cell_selection: include every 0.1 degree cell with positive projected intersection area with the exact frozen polygon
spatial_aggregation.slot_validity: basin slot is valid only when every positively weighted intersecting cell has a nonnegative finite sample for that exact half-hour timestamp
spatial_aggregation.partial_cell_missingness: UNKNOWN/null for entire basin slot; do not renormalize to available cells

temporal_aggregation.grid: exact 720-slot grid inherited from frozen predictor time plan
temporal_aggregation.window_rule: for each frozen window, sum slot accumulations only if every expected slot is valid; otherwise window value is null

retrieval.request_geometry: unique multipoint set of all IMERG cell centers required by the six frozen polygons

forbidden: read or infer observed 2015 activation labels during predictor extraction
read INGEMMET A6680 numeric morphometry during predictor extraction
query or retain any timestamp at or after 2015-03-23T19:30:00Z
use different temporal windows by basin
renormalize spatial weights when an intersecting IMERG cell is missing
move outlets or alter frozen polygons based on rainfall
derive or change operational thresholds from this retrospective extraction
